claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Azacyclonol is a polar, weakly basic piperidine metabolite of terfenadine with no reported intrinsic cytotoxicity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any weak antiproliferative signal reflecting nonspecific histamine-receptor-independent effects rather than a defined cytotoxic mechanism.
